auditName: BLOCK 56 — Language Switcher Visibility Fix & Translation Quality Audit

languageSwitcherFix.rootCause: The LanguageSwitcher was rendered in App.tsx inside a flex row alongside the 17-tab navigation bar with sm:flex-nowrap and without min-w-0 on <nav>. The 17 tabs intrinsically expand to over 2,250px, which pushed the LanguageSwitcher and utility actions completely beyond the right viewport boundary. Furthermore, the LanguageSwitcher button lacked shrink-0 and used right-0 instead of end-0 in RTL mode.
exactMinimalUIFix: Added shrink-0 and z-40 to LanguageSwitcher container.
Switched dropdown alignment from right-0 to end-0 for seamless RTL/LTR compatibility.
Added min-w-0 and shrink to <nav> in App.tsx so tabs scroll horizontally within allocated space without blowing out parent width.
Wrapped LanguageSwitcher and utility controls (outbox, auth, PWA) in a shrink-0 container to guarantee they are permanently visible on screen.
